explanation: The statement concerns AbstractMeasure.extendCoefficients and the type D(X, O). Both are defined in this library (TauCeti), not in Mathlib. The theorem says that extending coefficients along j is compatible with scalar multiplication. Its proof uses only the library's own finiteProjection_ext, followed by ext and simp. All of the content lies in the library's definitions, so no Mathlib declaration can state this result.
